title: In praise of memcached
summary: A blog post advocating for the continued use of memcached as a reliable distributed caching solution, highlighting its simplicity, performance, and battle-tested reliability compared to newer alternatives.
problem_solved: Reduces database load and improves application response times by caching frequently accessed data in memory.
why_valuable: Provides extremely low-latency data access with proven scalability and operational simplicity that newer caching solutions often lack.
